322	+| Point of Care ward gap | Chart 3 | Top 10 wards by not-done count -- the most actionable view in the workbook |
323	+| Day of week | Chart 4 | EM completion rate by admission weekday, against the overall EM rate |
324	+| EM turnaround | Chart 5 | Admission to 1st CCF creation, bucketed <=24h / 24-48h / 48-72h / >72h, plus median hours to first and to latest CCF |
325	+| EL lead time | Chart 6 | Elective lead time (days ahead of admission the FC was first created) vs. completion rate -- includes a "No CCF created" bucket at 0%, shown deliberately rather than hidden |
326	+
327	+---
328	+
329	+## 6. Checking that it worked
330	+
331	+Do this every month before circulating the report.
332	+
333	+**Step 1 -- the balance check.** The reconciliation waterfall is now at the
334	+bottom of the Summary sheet, under "Reconciliation -- for checking, not for the
335	+meeting". At the bottom of it there is a check row. If it flags a mismatch, do
336	+not circulate the report. Send it to whoever maintains the macro.
337	+
338	+**Step 2 -- do the totals look plausible?** Compare against last month. A
339	+completion rate that jumps by more than a few points, or a total admission count
340	+that moves sharply, usually means an export problem rather than a real change.
341	+
342	+**Step 3 -- is the missed FC count sensible?** It should be small. Hundreds means
343	+the export is wrong.
344	+
345	+**Step 4 -- read the warnings.** The Summary sheet flags unrecognised FC
346	+statuses, NCID wards not in your list, and unmatched staff names. None of these
347	+stop the report, but they tell you what to fix for next month.
348	+
349	+### Reference figures -- June 2026
350	+
351	+If you re-run the June 2026 export (`FCSummaryReport_20260730084420.xlsx`) with
352	+an empty roster and no File B, you should get exactly:
353	+
354	+| Stage | Count |
355	+|---|---|
356	+| Rows loaded | 7,434 |
357	+| After FC Mode filter | 7,432 |
358	+| After Cancelled filter | 7,432 |
359	+| Unique admissions | 6,659 |
360	+| Admissions with duplicate forms | 613 (773 rows removed) |
361	+| Of which Voided/Deleted only | 56 (8 EM, 48 EL) |
362	+| Of which unrecognised status | 0 |
363	+| Excluded -- Shopper enquiry only | 1 |
364	+| **Denominator** | **6,659** |
365	+| EM | 6,033 |
366	+| EL | 626 |
367	+| EL, of which NCID wards | 12 |
368	+
369	+The manually produced report for the same month gives EM 6,035 and EL 627. The
370	+difference is fully explained and the tool is the more accurate of the two:
371	+
372	+- **+1 EL** -- the manual report counts one admission whose only form was a
373	+  Shopper price enquiry. A price enquiry is not a counselling, so the tool
374	+  excludes it and says so on the Summary.
375	+- **+2 EM** -- the file contains only 6,033 Emergency admissions in total, so
376	+  6,035 is not possible. The manual sheet has two duplicate rows that survived
377	+  the combing step. With 751 rows to check by hand, two survivors is a good hit
378	+  rate -- it is exactly the kind of slip this tool removes.
379	+
380	+Use this comparison when presenting the tool to the team. Showing that it
381	+matches the accepted figures *and* explaining where it is more accurate is what
382	+gets it adopted.
383	+
384	+---
385	+
386	+## 7. Troubleshooting
387	+
388	+### 7.1 "No Financial Counselling rows found after the FC Mode filter"
389	+
390	+The FC Mode column does not contain the expected text. Open File A and look at
391	+the FC Mode column -- it should read `Financial Counselling - AH` or
392	+`Financial Counselling - Downtime`. If eFC has changed the wording, the macro
393	+needs updating.
394	+
395	+### 7.2 "Error: File A is missing the ... column"
396	+
397	+eFC has renamed or dropped a column in the export. Note which column the message
398	+names and send it to whoever maintains the macro. Do not rename columns by hand
399	+-- next month it will break again.
400	+
401	+### 7.3 The team sections are missing from the Summary
402	+
403	+Your roster did not match any names. Run **SuggestTeamsFromPointOfCare** (section
404	+2.5) and fill in the Config sheet, then re-run.
405	+
406	+### 7.4 The EL sheet is empty or nearly empty
407	+
408	+Check that File A was exported with **Elective inpa** included in the Admission
409	+Type filter. If you only exported Emergency, there is nothing for EL to show.
410	+
411	+### 7.5 The file name says the wrong month
412	+
413	+The report period comes from the Admission Date column. If your export covers
414	+more than one month, or the date range filter was wrong, the label follows the
415	+majority. Re-export with the correct range.
416	+
417	+### 7.6 My Config sheet has no column D
418	+
419	+You created it before the NCID ward list existed. Either:
420	+
421	+- If your roster is empty anyway: delete the whole Config sheet and run
422	+  **CreateConfigSheet** again, or
423	+- Type `NCID EL Point of Care` into cell **D1** exactly as written, then paste
424	+  the ward values below it. The header text must match exactly.
425	+
426	+### 7.7 A warning about unrecognised FC statuses
427	+
428	+eFC has added a status the tool does not know. The affected admissions are still
429	+counted -- as not completed -- so the report is safe to use, but tell whoever
430	+maintains the macro so the new status can be ranked properly.
431	+
432	+### 7.8 Something else went wrong
433	+
434	+The macro shows an error message rather than failing silently. Copy the whole
435	+message, note which step the progress bar was on, and pass both on.
436	+
437	+---
438	+
439	+## 8. Keeping the staff roster up to date
440	+
441	+The Config sheet's roster is the only part of this you need to maintain.
442	+
443	+**When someone joins or leaves,** add or remove them on the Config sheet. Names
444	+must match how they appear in eFC.
445	+
446	+**Watch out for drift between team leads.** The report rotates monthly. If each
447	+lead keeps their own copy of the macro workbook, the rosters slowly diverge and
448	+month-to-month figures stop being comparable for reasons nobody can see.
449	+
450	+Two ways to avoid that -- pick one and stick to it:
451	+
452	+- Keep **one** macro workbook on a shared drive that everyone uses, or
453	+- Keep one roster file on a shared drive and sync it: **ExportStaffRoster**
454	+  saves the roster to a CSV, **ImportStaffRoster** loads it back in. Both via
455	+  `Alt` + `F8`.
456	+
457	+**Warning about importing.** `ImportStaffRoster` does not merge -- it **wipes the
458	+existing roster and replaces it** with the contents of the CSV. It asks you to
459	+confirm first, but once you say yes the old roster is gone. Always run
460	+`ExportStaffRoster` first as a backup, even if you think you do not need it.
461	+
462	+**Check the Staff Roster Check sheet** each month. It lists names in the export
463	+that are not in your roster, busiest first. Adding the top few each month keeps
464	+coverage climbing with very little effort.
465	+
466	+---
467	+
468	+## 9. Open questions for the team
469	+
470	+Two rules are genuinely unsettled. The tool currently follows existing practice
471	+and flags the conflict rather than deciding for you. Both are worth a decision at
472	+a department meeting.
473	+
474	+**Voided and deleted forms.** The written process guide says admissions whose
475	+only form was voided or deleted should be **excluded** from the total. The
476	+manually produced report **includes** them. The tool currently includes them, to
477	+match the manual report. This affects 56 admissions out of about 6,600 -- roughly
478	+0.85% on the headline rate. Someone should decide which is intended.
479	+
480	+**EDVW discharges.** Patients discharged from EDVW may be short-stay cases that
481	+were never EDFC's responsibility. The tool labels them but still counts them as
482	+missed FC. If they should be excluded instead, the rule needs changing.
483	+
484	+---
485	+
486	+## Where things live
487	+
488	+| Thing | Where |
489	+|---|---|
490	+| Your settings | **Config** sheet in the macro workbook |
491	+| The code | `*.bas` files in the project folder |
492	+| The code as one file to paste into Excel | `FCCompletion_All_Modules.txt` |
493	+| The rules and why they are what they are | `docs/FC_Completion_Report_Process_Flow_for_Review.md` |
494	+| What has been built and what is outstanding | `docs/VBA_Code_Progress.md` |
495	+| The original manual process | `Guide to monthly processing of report 3.docx` |
496	+
497	+### Macros you can run (`Alt` + `F8`)
498	+
499	+| Name | What it does |
500	+|---|---|
501	+| `GenerateFCCompletionReport` | Produces the monthly report. This is the main one. |
502	+| `CreateConfigSheet` | Sets up the Config sheet. Once only. |
503	+| `SuggestTeamsFromPointOfCare` | Suggests a team for every staff name in an export. |
504	+| `ExportStaffRoster` | Saves the roster to a CSV. |
505	+| `ImportStaffRoster` | Loads a roster from a CSV. |

+# Monthly FC Completion Report -- User Guide
+
+For the team lead producing the monthly FC Completion Report.
+
+You do not need to understand the code to use this. You need to know which
+buttons to press, in what order, and how to tell whether the result is right.
+
+**Last updated:** 30 July 2026
+
+---
+
+## Contents
+
+1. [What this tool does](#1-what-this-tool-does)
+2. [One-time setup](#2-one-time-setup-do-this-once)
+3. [Pulling the eFC exports each month](#3-pulling-the-efc-exports-each-month)

+5. [Reading the output](#5-reading-the-output)
+6. [Checking that it worked](#6-checking-that-it-worked)
+7. [Troubleshooting](#7-troubleshooting)
+8. [Keeping the staff roster up to date](#8-keeping-the-staff-roster-up-to-date)
+9. [Open questions for the team](#9-open-questions-for-the-team)
+
+---
+
+## 1. What this tool does
+
+The report answers one question for the monthly department meeting: **of all the
+patients admitted last month, how many had their financial counselling
+completed, and who did the work?**
+
+It replaces the manual Excel process (sorting, conditional formatting, SWITCH
+and MINIFS formulas, then combing through several hundred duplicate rows by
+hand). The rules are identical -- the tool just applies them consistently and
+shows you its working.
+
+**Who runs it:** the team lead taking minutes for that month.
+
+**When:** 4 working days after the last day of the month. This gives Inflight
+time to catch up on missed FC cases from the final days of the month.
+
+**The one idea worth understanding:** the eFC export has one row per *FC form*.
+The report counts *admissions*. One admission can have several forms, so most of
+what the tool does is deciding which single form represents what really happened
+for each admission. It keeps the best outcome -- if anybody got that patient
+properly counselled, the admission counts as counselled.
+
+---
+
+## 2. One-time setup (do this once)
+
+You only do this the first time, or if you are setting the macro up on a new
+computer.
+
+### 2.1 Open the macro workbook and enable macros
+
+Open the macro workbook in Excel. If you see a yellow security warning bar,
+click **Enable Content**.
+
+### 2.2 Check the code compiles
+
+1. Press `Alt` + `F11` to open the VBA editor.
+2. Menu: **Debug** -> **Compile VBAProject**.
+3. Nothing should happen. If a dialog appears with an error, stop and send the
+   error text to whoever maintains the macro -- do not continue.
+4. Press `Alt` + `Q` to close the editor.
+
+### 2.3 Create the Config sheet
+
+The Config sheet holds your settings: which staff member belongs to which team,
+and which wards belong to NCID.
+
+1. Press `Alt` + `F8`.
+2. Select **CreateConfigSheet** and click **Run**.
+3. You will get a confirmation message. A new **Config** tab appears.
+
+If a message says *"Config sheet already exists"*, you already have one and
+nothing was changed. See [7.6](#76-my-config-sheet-has-no-column-d) if it is
+missing column D.
+
+### 2.4 Delete the placeholder rows
+
+The Config sheet is created with three fake rows -- **Staff A**, **Staff B**,
+**Staff C**. Delete these three rows now. If you leave them, they sit in your
+roster forever matching nobody.
+
+### 2.5 Bootstrap the staff roster
+
+The roster is the only way the tool can tell which team a staff member belongs
+to -- the eFC export contains names but no department. Without it, the report
+cannot say who did the work.
+
+Rather than typing in every name, let the tool suggest them:
+
+1. Press `Alt` + `F8`.
+2. Select **SuggestTeamsFromPointOfCare** and click **Run**.
+3. Choose any FC Summary Report export when prompted.
+4. It reads where each staff member usually works and suggests a team.
+
+You get a reference table in columns F to K of the Config sheet: staff name, how
+many rows they appear in, where they mostly work, a suggested team, and a
+confidence rating. It is **sorted with the busiest staff at the top**.
+
+It also writes into the roster itself, in columns A and B. For anyone already
+listed it fills the Team cell only if you left it blank -- it will never
+overwrite something you typed. For anyone new, it **adds a row with the
+suggested team already filled in**. So after one run, every name in the export
+is in your roster with a team against it.
+
+**Now do the important bit -- these are guesses, and they will look like
+facts.** Once the roster is auto-populated, the tool's roster warning goes quiet
+because every name now matches something. It checks whether names match, not
+whether the teams are correct. Nothing will tell you a team is wrong.
+
+So work down the table from the top and confirm it with the team leads:
+
+- Anything marked **"LOW -- please confirm"** had under half their work in one
+  place. Those guesses are close to worthless -- check every one.
+- Anyone landing in **Others** who you know does Inflight ward work. The guess
+  is based on where the *patient* was, not where the staff member works, and
+  ordinary ward names all fall through to Others. Inflight staff doing ward
+  follow-ups are systematically misclassified.
+- ED/EDFC suggestions are the most reliable, since emergency admissions are
+  unambiguous.
+
+You do **not** need all the names. In a typical month the busiest 30 staff cover
+over 90% of all rows. Start with those and add the rest as they come up.
+
+### 2.6 Check the NCID ward list
+
+Column D of the Config sheet, headed **NCID EL Point of Care**, comes prefilled
+with the ten confirmed NCID ward values. Have a look and add any that are
+missing. This list does not affect who is counted -- it only drives an extra
+"of which NCID wards" breakdown on the elective figures.
+
+---
+
+## 3. Pulling the eFC exports each month
+
+### File A -- FC Summary Report (required)
+
+In eFC, use the **FC Summary Report** function. Before exporting, filter:
+
+- **Admission date range:** the full month
+- **Admission Type:** Emergency, plus Elective inpa
+
+Save the file somewhere you can find it. This is the main input -- one row per FC
+form created that month.
+
+### File B -- Inflight Missed FC Report (optional)
+
+In eFC, use the **Inflight FC Report** with the **Missed FC** indicator ticked.
+
+This file lists admissions where nobody ever created an FC form. Those
+admissions do not appear in File A at all -- they are invisible to it -- so
+File B is the only way to include them in the total.
+
+**File B is optional.** If you cannot produce it, or the numbers look
+implausible, skip it and use the dashboard workaround instead.
+
+### The dashboard workaround (if File B is unavailable)
+
+1. In the eFC dashboard search, filter by admission type, admission date range,
+   and Admission Status = Actualised.
+2. Export to Excel.
+3. Count the CSNs with no FC ID.
+4. Type that single number into the macro's file picker (see step 4.2 below).
+
+Note: the missed FC count should normally be a small number. If it comes out in
+the hundreds, something is wrong with the export -- check it before using it.
+
+---
+
+## 4. Running the report
+
+### 4.1 Start the macro
+
+1. Press `Alt` + `F8`.
+2. Select **GenerateFCCompletionReport** and click **Run**.
+
+### 4.2 Select your files
+
+A window opens titled *"FC Completion Report -- Select Input Files"*:
+
+| Slot | What to do |
+|---|---|
+| **File A -- FC Summary Report** | Click Browse and pick it. Required. |
+| **File B -- Inflight Missed FC Report (optional)** | Pick it, or leave empty. |
+| **Missed FC count (dashboard workaround)** | Only used if File B is empty. Type the number, or leave at 0. |
+
+Each slot shows a status next to it -- **Valid**, **Invalid**, or **O** for not
+yet chosen. **Generate Report** becomes available once File A is valid.
+
+**Cancel** closes any files it opened and stops safely.
+
+### 4.3 Answer the roster question, if asked
+
+A progress bar runs through the steps. Partway through, one of two messages may
+appear.
+
+**"Staff Roster Not Matched"** -- your Config roster is empty, or none of the
+names in it appear in this export. It asks: *"Continue and produce completion
+statistics only?"*
+
+- **Yes** -- you get the completion figures, but the "who closed the CCF"
+  section and the four team indicators are left out entirely. Fine if you only
+  need the completion rate today.
+- **No** -- stops so you can fill in the roster first. Choose this if the
+  meeting needs team figures.
+
+**"Low Roster Coverage"** -- some names matched but under 70%. The report is
+produced anyway, and the unmatched names are listed on the Summary sheet with
+the busiest first, so you can see exactly which ones to add.
+
+### 4.4 Save the output
+
+A Save As dialog appears with a suggested name like
+`FCReportSummary_June2026.xlsx`. Pick where to save it. Your two input files are
+closed without being changed.
+
+A summary message tells you how many duplicates were resolved.
+
+---
+
+## 5. Reading the output
+
+The workbook has seven sheets.
+
+| Sheet | What it is |
+|---|---|
+| **EM** | Emergency admissions, one row per admission, after cleaning |
+| **EL** | Elective inpatient admissions, same |
+| **Missed FC** | The follow-up list from File B (absent if you did not supply File B) |
+| **Summary** | All the figures for the meeting, plus the two headline charts |
+| **Methodology** | Plain-English explanation of every rule, with this month's numbers |
+| **Staff Roster Check** | Which staff names matched the roster and which did not |
+| **Analytics** | Where the gap is by ward, completion by day of week, and turnaround/lead-time charts |
+
+### 5.1 The Summary sheet, top to bottom
+
+**The headline block** comes first -- three rows (Emergency, Elective, Combined),
+each showing the denominator, the completed count, and the completed percentage
+in large bold type. This is the number people came for; you should not need to
+scroll to see it.
+
+**Chart 1 (status mix)** follows immediately -- a single stacked bar per
+category (EM / EL / Combined) showing the full seven-band breakdown at a
+glance, with the green (completed) share labelled.
+
+**Completion status** comes next, as counts and percentages, unchanged in
+content from before:
+
+| Row | Colour | Meaning |
+|---|---|---|
+| FC completed with written acknowledgement | Green | Done properly, signed or acknowledged |
+| CCF explained but not signed | Pink | Explained, e.g. by phone, no signature obtained |
+| Attempted, no further follow-up | Light Green | Patient declined or was unable to sign |
+| FC not completed | Orange | Staff did not reach the patient in time |
+| Draft only | Light grey | A form was started but nothing came of it |
+| Voided/Deleted only | Grey | The only form for that admission was cancelled in eFC |
+| Missed FC | Dark grey | No form was ever created (from File B or your manual count) |
+| **Not completed (total)** | | The four rows above Missed FC, added together |
+
+That last subtotal is your single headline "not completed" figure. Everything is
+calculated three times: Emergency, Elective, and combined, with an extra **"of
+which NCID wards"** block within the elective figures.
+
+**Who closed the CCF** splits the work by team -- ED/EDFC, Inflight, NCID AO,
+ICH PSO, Admin/Managers, Others -- based on who last touched the CCF. If that
+field was blank it falls back to whoever created the form, and those rows are
+highlighted yellow so you can see it happened.
+
+**FC Activity Detail** gives the four workload indicators: FC created by EDFC,
+and CCF closed by EDFC, Inflight, and NCID AO.
+
+Both of these sections are missing entirely if your roster did not match --
+that is expected, not a fault.
+
+**Chart 2 (band counts, EM vs EL)** comes after the status tables -- the same
+seven bands as Chart 1, but as absolute counts side by side rather than a
+percentage mix, which is where the 100%-stacked chart above hides real volume
+differences between EM and EL.
+
+**The warnings block** follows: unrecognised FC statuses, NCID wards not in
+your configured list, and unmatched staff names.
+
+**The reconciliation waterfall** is last, under the heading "Reconciliation --
+for checking, not for the meeting". It walks from the raw file down to the
+final total, one line per filter, ending in a balance check. It is at the
+bottom because it is a working-check for you, not a meeting figure -- see
+section 6 for what to do with it.
+
+### 5.2 Why some blocks show no percentages
+
+If a block covers fewer than 30 admissions, percentages are hidden and you see
+counts plus a note. Percentages on a handful of cases are misleading -- "25%"
+out of twelve cases will be read as a real rate when it is three admissions.
+The same n<30 rule applies to the Analytics sheet's lead-time buckets.
+
+### 5.3 The Analytics sheet
+
+Four blocks, each with a chart:
+
+| Block | Chart | What it shows |
+|---|---|---|
+| Point of Care ward gap | Chart 3 | Top 10 wards by not-done count -- the most actionable view in the workbook |
+| Day of week | Chart 4 | EM completion rate by admission weekday, against the overall EM rate |
+| EM turnaround | Chart 5 | Admission to 1st CCF creation, bucketed <=24h / 24-48h / 48-72h / >72h, plus median hours to first and to latest CCF |
+| EL lead time | Chart 6 | Elective lead time (days ahead of admission the FC was first created) vs. completion rate -- includes a "No CCF created" bucket at 0%, shown deliberately rather than hidden |
+
+---
+
+## 6. Checking that it worked
+
+Do this every month before circulating the report.
+
+**Step 1 -- the balance check.** The reconciliation waterfall is now at the
+bottom of the Summary sheet, under "Reconciliation -- for checking, not for the
+meeting". At the bottom of it there is a check row. If it flags a mismatch, do
+not circulate the report. Send it to whoever maintains the macro.
+
+**Step 2 -- do the totals look plausible?** Compare against last month. A
+completion rate that jumps by more than a few points, or a total admission count
+that moves sharply, usually means an export problem rather than a real change.
+
+**Step 3 -- is the missed FC count sensible?** It should be small. Hundreds means
+the export is wrong.
+
+**Step 4 -- read the warnings.** The Summary sheet flags unrecognised FC
+statuses, NCID wards not in your list, and unmatched staff names. None of these
+stop the report, but they tell you what to fix for next month.
+
+### Reference figures -- June 2026
+
+If you re-run the June 2026 export (`FCSummaryReport_20260730084420.xlsx`) with
+an empty roster and no File B, you should get exactly:
+
+| Stage | Count |
+|---|---|
+| Rows loaded | 7,434 |
+| After FC Mode filter | 7,432 |
+| After Cancelled filter | 7,432 |
+| Unique admissions | 6,659 |
+| Admissions with duplicate forms | 613 (773 rows removed) |
+| Of which Voided/Deleted only | 56 (8 EM, 48 EL) |
+| Of which unrecognised status | 0 |
+| Excluded -- Shopper enquiry only | 1 |
+| **Denominator** | **6,659** |
+| EM | 6,033 |
+| EL | 626 |
+| EL, of which NCID wards | 12 |
+
+The manually produced report for the same month gives EM 6,035 and EL 627. The
+difference is fully explained and the tool is the more accurate of the two:
+
+- **+1 EL** -- the manual report counts one admission whose only form was a
+  Shopper price enquiry. A price enquiry is not a counselling, so the tool
+  excludes it and says so on the Summary.
+- **+2 EM** -- the file contains only 6,033 Emergency admissions in total, so
+  6,035 is not possible. The manual sheet has two duplicate rows that survived
+  the combing step. With 751 rows to check by hand, two survivors is a good hit
+  rate -- it is exactly the kind of slip this tool removes.
+
+Use this comparison when presenting the tool to the team. Showing that it
+matches the accepted figures *and* explaining where it is more accurate is what
+gets it adopted.
+
+---
+
+## 7. Troubleshooting
+
+### 7.1 "No Financial Counselling rows found after the FC Mode filter"
+
+The FC Mode column does not contain the expected text. Open File A and look at
+the FC Mode column -- it should read `Financial Counselling - AH` or
+`Financial Counselling - Downtime`. If eFC has changed the wording, the macro
+needs updating.
+
+### 7.2 "Error: File A is missing the ... column"
+
+eFC has renamed or dropped a column in the export. Note which column the message
+names and send it to whoever maintains the macro. Do not rename columns by hand
+-- next month it will break again.
+
+### 7.3 The team sections are missing from the Summary
+
+Your roster did not match any names. Run **SuggestTeamsFromPointOfCare** (section
+2.5) and fill in the Config sheet, then re-run.
+
+### 7.4 The EL sheet is empty or nearly empty
+
+Check that File A was exported with **Elective inpa** included in the Admission
+Type filter. If you only exported Emergency, there is nothing for EL to show.
+
+### 7.5 The file name says the wrong month
+
+The report period comes from the Admission Date column. If your export covers
+more than one month, or the date range filter was wrong, the label follows the
+majority. Re-export with the correct range.
+
+### 7.6 My Config sheet has no column D
+
+You created it before the NCID ward list existed. Either:
+
+- If your roster is empty anyway: delete the whole Config sheet and run
+  **CreateConfigSheet** again, or
+- Type `NCID EL Point of Care` into cell **D1** exactly as written, then paste
+  the ward values below it. The header text must match exactly.
+
+### 7.7 A warning about unrecognised FC statuses
+
+eFC has added a status the tool does not know. The affected admissions are still
+counted -- as not completed -- so the report is safe to use, but tell whoever
+maintains the macro so the new status can be ranked properly.
+
+### 7.8 Something else went wrong
+
+The macro shows an error message rather than failing silently. Copy the whole
+message, note which step the progress bar was on, and pass both on.
+
+---
+
+## 8. Keeping the staff roster up to date
+
+The Config sheet's roster is the only part of this you need to maintain.
+
+**When someone joins or leaves,** add or remove them on the Config sheet. Names
+must match how they appear in eFC.
+
+**Watch out for drift between team leads.** The report rotates monthly. If each
+lead keeps their own copy of the macro workbook, the rosters slowly diverge and
+month-to-month figures stop being comparable for reasons nobody can see.
+
+Two ways to avoid that -- pick one and stick to it:
+
+- Keep **one** macro workbook on a shared drive that everyone uses, or
+- Keep one roster file on a shared drive and sync it: **ExportStaffRoster**
+  saves the roster to a CSV, **ImportStaffRoster** loads it back in. Both via
+  `Alt` + `F8`.
+
+**Warning about importing.** `ImportStaffRoster` does not merge -- it **wipes the
+existing roster and replaces it** with the contents of the CSV. It asks you to
+confirm first, but once you say yes the old roster is gone. Always run
+`ExportStaffRoster` first as a backup, even if you think you do not need it.
+
+**Check the Staff Roster Check sheet** each month. It lists names in the export
+that are not in your roster, busiest first. Adding the top few each month keeps
+coverage climbing with very little effort.
+
+---
+
+## 9. Open questions for the team
+
+Two rules are genuinely unsettled. The tool currently follows existing practice
+and flags the conflict rather than deciding for you. Both are worth a decision at
+a department meeting.
+
+**Voided and deleted forms.** The written process guide says admissions whose
+only form was voided or deleted should be **excluded** from the total. The
+manually produced report **includes** them. The tool currently includes them, to
+match the manual report. This affects 56 admissions out of about 6,600 -- roughly
+0.85% on the headline rate. Someone should decide which is intended.
+
+**EDVW discharges.** Patients discharged from EDVW may be short-stay cases that
+were never EDFC's responsibility. The tool labels them but still counts them as
+missed FC. If they should be excluded instead, the rule needs changing.
+
+---
+

+
+| Thing | Where |
+|---|---|
+| Your settings | **Config** sheet in the macro workbook |
+| The code | `*.bas` files in the project folder |
+| The code as one file to paste into Excel | `FCCompletion_All_Modules.txt` |
+| The rules and why they are what they are | `docs/FC_Completion_Report_Process_Flow_for_Review.md` |
+| What has been built and what is outstanding | `docs/VBA_Code_Progress.md` |
+| The original manual process | `Guide to monthly processing of report 3.docx` |
+
+### Macros you can run (`Alt` + `F8`)
+
+| Name | What it does |
+|---|---|
+| `GenerateFCCompletionReport` | Produces the monthly report. This is the main one. |
+| `CreateConfigSheet` | Sets up the Config sheet. Once only. |
+| `SuggestTeamsFromPointOfCare` | Suggests a team for every staff name in an export. |
+| `ExportStaffRoster` | Saves the roster to a CSV. |
+| `ImportStaffRoster` | Loads a roster from a CSV. |

    r = r + 1

    Dim emDenom As Long, elDenom As Long, combDenom As Long
    Dim emCompleted As Long, elCompleted As Long, combCompleted As Long
    emDenom = emEnc + missedEM
    elDenom = elEnc + missedEL
    combDenom = emDenom + elDenom
    emCompleted = emGreen + emPink + emLtGreen
    elCompleted = elGreen + elPink + elLtGreen
    combCompleted = emCompleted + elCompleted

    WriteHeadlineRow ws, r, "Emergency (EM)", emDenom, emCompleted
    WriteHeadlineRow ws, r, "Elective Inpatient (EL)", elDenom, elCompleted
    WriteHeadlineRow ws, r, "Combined (EM + EL)", combDenom, combCompleted
    r = r + 1
End Sub

Private Sub WriteHeadlineRow(ws As Worksheet, ByRef r As Long, label As String, denom As Long, completed As Long)
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = label
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Bold = True
    ws.Cells(r, 2).Value = denom
    ws.Cells(r, 3).Value = completed
    If denom > 0 Then
        ws.Cells(r, 4).Value = completed / denom
        ws.Cells(r, 4).NumberFormat = "0.0%"
    Else
        ws.Cells(r, 4).Value = ""
    End If
    ws.Cells(r, 4).Font.Bold = True
    ws.Cells(r, 4).Font.Size = 14
    r = r + 1
End Sub

Private Sub WriteSummarySheet(ws As Worksheet, reportLabel As String, waterfall As Object, _
        emEnc As Long, elEnc As Long, missedEM As Long, missedEL As Long, missedFCSourceLabel As String, _
        emGreen As Long, emPink As Long, emLtGreen As Long, emOrange As Long, emDraft As Long, emVoided As Long, _
        elGreen As Long, elPink As Long, elLtGreen As Long, elOrange As Long, elDraft As Long, elVoided As Long, _
        emTeams As Object, elTeams As Object, _
        emBlankCCF As Long, elBlankCCF As Long, _
        emEdInit As Long, emEdFull As Long, emInflFull As Long, emNcidFull As Long, _
        elEdInit As Long, elEdFull As Long, elInflFull As Long, elNcidFull As Long, _
        ncidEnc As Long, ncidGreen As Long, ncidPink As Long, ncidLtGreen As Long, ncidOrange As Long, _
        ncidDraft As Long, ncidVoided As Long, ncidTeams As Object, ncidBlankCCF As Long, _
        ncidEdInit As Long, ncidEdFull As Long, ncidInflFull As Long, ncidNcidFull As Long, _
        voidedTotal As Long, otherEncCount As Long, missedOther As Long, _
        unrecognisedStatuses As Object, unmatchedNCIDWards As Object, _
        inflightExceptionApplied As Long, inflightExceptionBlocked As Long, _
        modeFilterExcludedEncounters As Long, _
        suppressTeamBlocks As Boolean, rosterCoverage As Double, unmatchedNames As Object, _
        ByRef chart1AnchorRow As Long, ByRef chart2AnchorRow As Long)

    Dim r As Long
    r = 1

    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "FC Completion Report -- " & reportLabel
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Bold = True
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Size = 14
    r = r + 2

    ' ---- HEADLINE BLOCK (new) ----
    WriteHeadlineBlock ws, r, emEnc, missedEM, emGreen, emPink, emLtGreen, _
        elEnc, missedEL, elGreen, elPink, elLtGreen
    chart1AnchorRow = r
    r = r + 20   ' reserve space for Chart 1 (~420x260pt, well under 20 default-height rows)

    If suppressTeamBlocks Then
        ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "STAFF ROSTER NOT MATCHED -- team attribution and all four " & _
            "numerator indicators are unavailable this run (the Config roster is empty or matched " & _
            "no names in this export). Completion statistics below are still valid."
        ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Bold = True
        ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Color = RGB(180, 0, 0)
        r = r + 2
    End If

    ' ---- EM block (always computed) ----
    WriteSummaryBlock ws, r, "EMERGENCY (EM) ADMISSIONS", _
        emEnc, missedEM, missedFCSourceLabel, emGreen, emPink, emLtGreen, emOrange, emDraft, emVoided, _
        emTeams, emBlankCCF, emEdInit, emEdFull, emInflFull, emNcidFull, suppressTeamBlocks

    ' ---- EL block (Revert A, 2026-07-30: always computed -- Admission Type alone) ----
    WriteSummaryBlock ws, r, "ELECTIVE INPATIENT (EL) ADMISSIONS", _
        elEnc, missedEL, missedFCSourceLabel, elGreen, elPink, elLtGreen, elOrange, elDraft, elVoided, _
        elTeams, elBlankCCF, elEdInit, elEdFull, elInflFull, elNcidFull, suppressTeamBlocks

    ' ---- of which NCID wards (PART 3.1 sub-block under EL) ----
    WriteSummaryBlock ws, r, "  of which NCID wards (subset of EL)", _
        ncidEnc, 0, missedFCSourceLabel, ncidGreen, ncidPink, ncidLtGreen, ncidOrange, ncidDraft, ncidVoided, _
        ncidTeams, ncidBlankCCF, ncidEdInit, ncidEdFull, ncidInflFull, ncidNcidFull, suppressTeamBlocks

    ' ---- Combined block ----
    Dim combTeams As Object
    Set combTeams = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
    InitTeamCounts combTeams
    Dim tk As Variant
    For Each tk In emTeams.Keys
        combTeams(CStr(tk)) = emTeams(CStr(tk)) + elTeams(CStr(tk))
    Next tk

    WriteSummaryBlock ws, r, "COMBINED (EM + EL)", _
        emEnc + elEnc, missedEM + missedEL, missedFCSourceLabel, _
        emGreen + elGreen, emPink + elPink, emLtGreen + elLtGreen, emOrange + elOrange, _
        emDraft + elDraft, emVoided + elVoided, _
        combTeams, emBlankCCF + elBlankCCF, _
        emEdInit + elEdInit, emEdFull + elEdFull, _
        emInflFull + elInflFull, emNcidFull + elNcidFull, suppressTeamBlocks

    chart2AnchorRow = r
    r = r + 20   ' reserve space for Chart 2

    ' ---- FOOTNOTES ----
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "FOOTNOTES"
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Bold = True
    r = r + 1

    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "Voided/Deleted-only encounters (counted IN the denominator and IN " & _
        "'not completed', REVERT B 2026-07-30): " & voidedTotal
    r = r + 1

    If otherEncCount > 0 Or missedOther > 0 Then
        ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "Encounters with unrecognised Admission Type (not EM or EL): " & _
            otherEncCount & " from File A, " & missedOther & " from File B"
        r = r + 1
    End If

    If modeFilterExcludedEncounters > 0 Then
        ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = modeFilterExcludedEncounters & " encounter(s) excluded -- only form " & _
            "was a Shopper enquiry or other non-FC mode."
        r = r + 1
    End If

    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "Missed FC source: " & missedFCSourceLabel
    r = r + 1

    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "Inflight duplicate exception applied (ED/EDFC candidate present, winner " & _
        "priority <= 2): " & inflightExceptionApplied & " encounter(s); blocked by the priority " & _
        "guard and fell back to the plain lowest-priority rule: " & inflightExceptionBlocked & " encounter(s)"
    r = r + 2

    ' ---- Unrecognised FC Status warning block ----
    If Not unrecognisedStatuses Is Nothing Then
        If unrecognisedStatuses.Count > 0 Then
            ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "UNRECOGNISED FC STATUS VALUES (counted as 'Draft only -- no FC " & _
                "outcome', priority 98 -- still IN the denominator, but check for typos or new eFC statuses)"
            ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Bold = True
            ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Color = RGB(180, 80, 0)
            r = r + 1

            Dim uk As Variant
            For Each uk In unrecognisedStatuses.Keys
                ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "  " & CStr(uk)
                ws.Cells(r, 2).Value = unrecognisedStatuses(uk)
                r = r + 1
            Next uk
            r = r + 1
        End If
    End If

    ' ---- Unmatched "NCID" Point of Care values warning (PART 3.1) ----
    If Not unmatchedNCIDWards Is Nothing Then
        If unmatchedNCIDWards.Count > 0 Then
            ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "POINT OF CARE VALUES CONTAINING 'NCID' NOT IN THE CONFIGURED LIST " & _
                "(still counted normally -- check whether a new NCID ward needs adding to the Config " & _
                "sheet's 'NCID EL Point of Care' list)"
            ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Bold = True
            ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Color = RGB(180, 80, 0)
            r = r + 1

            Dim nk As Variant
            For Each nk In unmatchedNCIDWards.Keys
                ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "  " & CStr(nk)
                ws.Cells(r, 2).Value = unmatchedNCIDWards(nk)
                r = r + 1
            Next nk
            r = r + 1
        End If
    End If

    ' ---- Low roster coverage: unmatched staff names (PART 4.1) ----
    If Not suppressTeamBlocks And rosterCoverage < 0.7 And rosterCoverage > 0 Then
        If Not unmatchedNames Is Nothing Then
            If unmatchedNames.Count > 0 Then
                ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "LOW ROSTER COVERAGE (" & Format(rosterCoverage, "0.0%") & _
                    ") -- UNMATCHED STAFF NAMES (add these to the Config roster for the biggest gain)"
                ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Bold = True
                ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Color = RGB(180, 80, 0)
                r = r + 1

                ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "Staff Name (as it appears in this export)"
                ws.Cells(r, 2).Value = "Encounter Count"
                ws.Range(ws.Cells(r, 1), ws.Cells(r, 2)).Font.Bold = True
                r = r + 1

                Dim sortedNames As Variant
                sortedNames = SortDictKeysDescending(unmatchedNames)
                Dim si As Long
                For si = LBound(sortedNames) To UBound(sortedNames)
                    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "  " & CStr(sortedNames(si))
                    ws.Cells(r, 2).Value = unmatchedNames(CStr(sortedNames(si)))
                    r = r + 1
                Next si
                r = r + 1
            End If
        End If
    End If

    ' ---- RECONCILIATION WATERFALL (moved to the bottom -- for checking, not for the meeting) ----
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "Reconciliation -- for checking, not for the meeting"
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Bold = True
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Italic = True
    r = r + 1
    WriteReconciliationWaterfall ws, r, waterfall, missedEM + missedEL + missedOther, _
        voidedTotal, unrecognisedStatuses.Count, emEnc, elEnc, otherEncCount

    ws.Columns("A:A").ColumnWidth = 70
    ws.Columns("B:B").ColumnWidth = 12
    ws.Columns("C:C").ColumnWidth = 10
    ws.Columns("D:D").ColumnWidth = 50
End Sub

' Writes both charts' ChartData blocks and creates the charts. Guarded per-
' chart with On Error inside AddChartFromBlock -- a failure on one chart
' never blocks the other or aborts report generation.
Private Sub BuildSummaryCharts(outWb As Workbook, wsSummary As Worksheet, _
        chart1AnchorRow As Long, chart2AnchorRow As Long, _
        emEnc As Long, elEnc As Long, missedEM As Long, missedEL As Long, _
        emGreen As Long, emPink As Long, emLtGreen As Long, emOrange As Long, emDraft As Long, emVoided As Long, _
        elGreen As Long, elPink As Long, elLtGreen As Long, elOrange As Long, elDraft As Long, elVoided As Long)

    Dim cd As Worksheet
    Set cd = EnsureChartDataSheet(outWb)

    ' ---- Chart 1 block: ChartData!A1:H4 (rows = EM/EL/Combined, cols = 7 bands) ----
    cd.Cells(1, 1).Value = ""
    cd.Cells(1, 2).Value = "Green": cd.Cells(1, 3).Value = "Pink": cd.Cells(1, 4).Value = "Light Green"
    cd.Cells(1, 5).Value = "Orange": cd.Cells(1, 6).Value = "Draft only": cd.Cells(1, 7).Value = "Voided only"
    cd.Cells(1, 8).Value = "Missed FC"

    cd.Cells(2, 1).Value = "EM"
    cd.Cells(2, 2).Value = emGreen: cd.Cells(2, 3).Value = emPink: cd.Cells(2, 4).Value = emLtGreen
    cd.Cells(2, 5).Value = emOrange: cd.Cells(2, 6).Value = emDraft: cd.Cells(2, 7).Value = emVoided
    cd.Cells(2, 8).Value = missedEM

    cd.Cells(3, 1).Value = "EL"
    cd.Cells(3, 2).Value = elGreen: cd.Cells(3, 3).Value = elPink: cd.Cells(3, 4).Value = elLtGreen
    cd.Cells(3, 5).Value = elOrange: cd.Cells(3, 6).Value = elDraft: cd.Cells(3, 7).Value = elVoided
    cd.Cells(3, 8).Value = missedEL

    cd.Cells(4, 1).Value = "Combined"
    cd.Cells(4, 2).Value = emGreen + elGreen: cd.Cells(4, 3).Value = emPink + elPink
    cd.Cells(4, 4).Value = emLtGreen + elLtGreen: cd.Cells(4, 5).Value = emOrange + elOrange
    cd.Cells(4, 6).Value = emDraft + elDraft: cd.Cells(4, 7).Value = emVoided + elVoided
    cd.Cells(4, 8).Value = missedEM + missedEL

    Dim chart1Colours As Variant
    chart1Colours = Array(BAND_COLOR_GREEN, BAND_COLOR_PINK, BAND_COLOR_LTGREEN, BAND_COLOR_ORANGE, _
        BAND_COLOR_DRAFT, BAND_COLOR_VOIDED, BAND_COLOR_MISSED)

    Dim co1 As ChartObject
    Set co1 = AddChartFromBlock(wsSummary, wsSummary.Cells(chart1AnchorRow, 1), _
        cd.Range(cd.Cells(1, 1), cd.Cells(4, 8)), xlColumnStacked100, _
        "Status Mix -- EM / EL / Combined", 420, 260, chart1Colours, "chtStatusMix")

    If Not co1 Is Nothing Then
        ' Data labels showing percentage on the Green segment only (the
        ' others clutter it) -- computed manually since 100%-stacked column
        ' charts do not expose a built-in "show percentage" label type.
        On Error Resume Next
        Dim greenTotals(1 To 3) As Long, rowTotals(1 To 3) As Long
        greenTotals(1) = emGreen: greenTotals(2) = elGreen: greenTotals(3) = emGreen + elGreen
        rowTotals(1) = emGreen + emPink + emLtGreen + emOrange + emDraft + emVoided + missedEM
        rowTotals(2) = elGreen + elPink + elLtGreen + elOrange + elDraft + elVoided + missedEL
        rowTotals(3) = rowTotals(1) + rowTotals(2)

        Dim pIdx As Long
        For pIdx = 1 To 3
            With co1.Chart.SeriesCollection(1).Points(pIdx)
                .HasDataLabel = True
                If rowTotals(pIdx) > 0 Then
                    .DataLabel.Text = Format(greenTotals(pIdx) / rowTotals(pIdx), "0%")
                End If
            End With
        Next pIdx
        On Error GoTo 0
    Else
        wsSummary.Cells(chart1AnchorRow, 1).Value = "(Chart 1 could not be created -- see table above.)"
        wsSummary.Cells(chart1AnchorRow, 1).Font.Italic = True
    End If

    ' ---- Chart 2 block: ChartData!A8:C16 (rows = 7 bands, cols = EM/EL) ----
    cd.Cells(8, 1).Value = "": cd.Cells(8, 2).Value = "EM": cd.Cells(8, 3).Value = "EL"
    cd.Cells(9, 1).Value = "Green": cd.Cells(9, 2).Value = emGreen: cd.Cells(9, 3).Value = elGreen
    cd.Cells(10, 1).Value = "Pink": cd.Cells(10, 2).Value = emPink: cd.Cells(10, 3).Value = elPink
    cd.Cells(11, 1).Value = "Light Green": cd.Cells(11, 2).Value = emLtGreen: cd.Cells(11, 3).Value = elLtGreen
    cd.Cells(12, 1).Value = "Orange": cd.Cells(12, 2).Value = emOrange: cd.Cells(12, 3).Value = elOrange
    cd.Cells(13, 1).Value = "Draft only": cd.Cells(13, 2).Value = emDraft: cd.Cells(13, 3).Value = elDraft
    cd.Cells(14, 1).Value = "Voided only": cd.Cells(14, 2).Value = emVoided: cd.Cells(14, 3).Value = elVoided
    cd.Cells(15, 1).Value = "Missed FC": cd.Cells(15, 2).Value = missedEM: cd.Cells(15, 3).Value = missedEL

    Dim chart2Colours As Variant
    chart2Colours = Array(RGB(31, 73, 125), RGB(128, 128, 128))

    Dim co2 As ChartObject
    Set co2 = AddChartFromBlock(wsSummary, wsSummary.Cells(chart2AnchorRow, 1), _
        cd.Range(cd.Cells(8, 1), cd.Cells(15, 3)), xlColumnClustered, _
        "Band Counts -- EM vs EL", 420, 260, chart2Colours, "chtBandCounts")

    If co2 Is Nothing Then
        wsSummary.Cells(chart2AnchorRow, 1).Value = "(Chart 2 could not be created -- see tables above.)"
        wsSummary.Cells(chart2AnchorRow, 1).Font.Italic = True
    End If
End Sub

Private Sub WriteELLeadTimeBlock(ws As Worksheet, outWb As Workbook, ByRef r As Long, _
        fullData As Variant, aLastRow As Long, secArr() As Long, priArr() As Long, _
        admDateCol As Long, firstCCFDtCol As Long)

    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "EL LEAD TIME VS. COMPLETION"
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Bold = True
    ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Size = 12
    r = r + 1

    If admDateCol = 0 Or firstCCFDtCol = 0 Then
        ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "(Admission Date or '1st CCF Creation Date-Time' column not found -- " & _
            "this block is unavailable.)"
        ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Italic = True
        r = r + 2
        Exit Sub
    End If

    ' Bucket order fixed (do not sort): 14+ days, 7-14 days, 1-7 days,
    ' Same day or after, No CCF created. Bucket 5 ("No CCF created") is
    ' every EL encounter with a blank 1st CCF Creation Date-Time -- it MUST
    ' appear as its own bar at 0% completion, never excluded (excluding it
    ' would hide a large share of elective admissions).
    Dim bucketN(1 To 5) As Long, bucketGreen(1 To 5) As Long
    Dim bucketLabels(1 To 5) As String
    bucketLabels(1) = "14+ days": bucketLabels(2) = "7-14 days": bucketLabels(3) = "1-7 days"
    bucketLabels(4) = "Same day or after": bucketLabels(5) = "No CCF created"

    Dim i As Long, admDt As Date, firstDt As Date, leadDays As Long, bkt As Long
    For i = 2 To aLastRow
        If secArr(i) = 2 Then   ' SEC_EL
            If TryParseMDYDateTime(CStr(fullData(i, admDateCol)), admDt) Then
                If TryParseMDYDateTime(CStr(fullData(i, firstCCFDtCol)), firstDt) Then
                    leadDays = CLng(DateValue(admDt) - DateValue(firstDt))
                    bkt = LeadDayBucket(leadDays)
                Else
                    bkt = 5   ' No CCF created
                End If
                bucketN(bkt) = bucketN(bkt) + 1
                If bkt <> 5 Then
                    If IsGreenPriority(priArr(i)) Then bucketGreen(bkt) = bucketGreen(bkt) + 1
                End If
            End If
        End If
    Next i

    ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "Lead Time Bucket"
    ws.Cells(r, 2).Value = "n"
    ws.Cells(r, 3).Value = "Completed %"
    ws.Range(ws.Cells(r, 1), ws.Cells(r, 3)).Font.Bold = True
    r = r + 1

    Dim bPct(1 To 5) As Double
    Dim smallN As Boolean
    Dim bk As Long
    For bk = 1 To 5
        ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = bucketLabels(bk)
        ws.Cells(r, 2).Value = bucketN(bk)
        smallN = (bucketN(bk) < 30)
        If bk = 5 Then
            bPct(bk) = 0
            If Not smallN Then
                ws.Cells(r, 3).Value = 0
                ws.Cells(r, 3).NumberFormat = "0.0%"
            End If
        ElseIf bucketN(bk) > 0 Then
            bPct(bk) = bucketGreen(bk) / bucketN(bk)
            If Not smallN Then
                ws.Cells(r, 3).Value = bPct(bk)
                ws.Cells(r, 3).NumberFormat = "0.0%"
            End If
        End If
        If smallN Then
            ws.Cells(r, 3).Value = ""
            ws.Cells(r, 4).Value = "n < 30 -- percentage suppressed"
            ws.Cells(r, 4).Font.Italic = True
        End If
        r = r + 1
    Next bk
    r = r + 1

    ' ---- ChartData block: rows 57-63, cols A:B ----
    Dim cd As Worksheet
    Set cd = EnsureChartDataSheet(outWb)
    cd.Cells(57, 1).Value = ""
    cd.Cells(57, 2).Value = "Completed %"
    For bk = 1 To 5
        cd.Cells(57 + bk, 1).Value = bucketLabels(bk) & " (n=" & bucketN(bk) & ")"
        cd.Cells(57 + bk, 2).Value = bPct(bk)
    Next bk

    Dim co6 As ChartObject
    Set co6 = AddChartFromBlock(ws, ws.Cells(r, 1), _
        cd.Range(cd.Cells(57, 1), cd.Cells(62, 2)), xlColumnClustered, _
        "EL Lead Time vs. Completion", 420, 260, Array(BAND_COLOR_GREEN), "chtELLeadTime")

    If Not co6 Is Nothing Then
        r = r + 19
        ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "Elective FCs completed further ahead of admission are markedly more " & _
            "likely to be closed. Lead time is measured to the FIRST CCF."
        ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Italic = True
        r = r + 2
    Else
        ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = "(Chart 6 could not be created -- see table above.)"
        ws.Cells(r, 1).Font.Italic = True
        r = r + 2
    End If
End Sub

Private Sub HighlightCCFFallbackRows(ws As Worksheet)
    Dim latestCol As Long, closerCol As Long, encCol As Long
    latestCol = FindColByHeader(ws, "Latest CCF Creation User")
    closerCol = FindColByHeader(ws, "CCF Closed By")

    lastRow = ws.Cells(ws.Rows.Count, encCol).End(xlUp).Row
    If lastRow < 2 Then Exit Sub

    Dim i As Long
    For i = 2 To lastRow

           CellStr(ws.Cells(i, closerCol).Value) <> "" Then
            If rng Is Nothing Then
                Set rng = ws.Cells(i, closerCol)
            Else
                Set rng = Union(rng, ws.Cells(i, closerCol))
            End If
        End If
    Next i

    If Not rng Is Nothing Then rng.Interior.Color = RGB(255, 255, 153)
